notes: Historical Canvas measurements are not a fresh controlled baseline rerun. That rerun was blocked by a local benchmark-server Git subprocess permission error.
The six acceptance minute runs and first part of the ten-minute run had the translucent startup veil present. The veil was dismissed in the latter part of the sustained run.
The final manual sample at 14:08:57 is an unobstructed wind-only ribbon run on the final renderer. The preceding manual sample at 14:06:52 has stormwater active.
Initial traceMs measured ribbon preparation; final diagnostics separate ribbonPrepareMs and the 5 Hz traceMs.
GPU fence completions do not prove physical presentation. Compositor traces remain outstanding.
